signal: EliseAI was named a trusted partner by OpenAI in January 2026 and hit $200M ARR

email.subject1: a signal play for EliseAI's partners
email.body1:
Vincent, saw EliseAI was named an OpenAI trusted partner and just crossed 200M in ARR.

Growth like that usually means the partner ecosystem can source far more co-sell pipeline than the team can actually cover, and that is where joint deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up across the partner network on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EliseAI's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Vincent, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

Partner-sourced pipeline usually outruns the team's ability to activate it, so warm co-sell intros sit cold and the partnership underdelivers on its number. The fix is coverage, not more BD hires.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a co-sell pilot playbook and how EliseAI can run partner-sourced outreach at scale, with every touch personalized to the partner's accounts.
email.body3:
Vincent, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to 2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's partner reply rate likely compares to peers. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Vincent, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority right now, no problem at all. Rapid growth is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through three personalized drafts to your top partner targets plus a co-sell playbook? I will tailor it to EliseAI either way.
